title: Sport psychology, peak performance and athletes’ mental health, with Jamie Shapiro, PhD

sentences.en: The mental health of elite athletes has been much in the news this year.
sentences.zh: 今年，精英运动员的心理健康问题频频见诸报端。

sentences.en: In May, tennis star Naomi Osaka withdrew from the French Open and then from Wimbledon, saying she needed to focus on her mental health.
sentences.zh: 五月，网球明星大坂直美退出了法国网球公开赛，随后又退出了温布尔登网球锦标赛，称她需要专注于自己的心理健康。

sentences.en: At the Olympic Games in Tokyo, gymnast Simone Biles, the greatest of all time, skipped most of the competition because of a mental performance block.
sentences.zh: 在东京奥运会上，被誉为史上最伟大的体操运动员西蒙·拜尔斯，因心理上的动作障碍退出了大部分比赛。

sentences.en: And sprinter Noah Lyles, who won a bronze medal in the 200-meter dash, spent much of his post-race interview discussing his battle with depression and anxiety.
sentences.zh: 而在200米短跑中获得铜牌的短跑选手诺亚·莱尔斯，在赛后采访中花了大量时间讨论他与抑郁症和焦虑症的抗争。

sentences.en: The world has noticed.
sentences.zh: 全世界都注意到了这一点。

sentences.en: One media analytics company found that in the week following Biles' withdrawal from the Olympic competition,
sentences.zh: 一家媒体分析公司发现，在拜尔斯退出奥运比赛后的一周内，

sentences.en: more than 9,000 news stories generated more than 2 million social media interactions that mentioned the gymnast and her mental health.
sentences.zh: 有超过9000篇新闻报道引发了超过200万次社交媒体互动，其中都提到了这位体操运动员及其心理健康问题。

sentences.en: This media attention may be new, but the field of sports psychology is not.
sentences.zh: 这种媒体关注或许是新鲜事，但运动心理学领域却并非如此。

sentences.en: Psychologists were on the ground with the Olympic athletes in Tokyo, and an increasing number of professional and college sport teams and athletes at all levels
sentences.zh: 心理学家们在东京奥运会期间就与运动员们并肩作战，越来越多的职业和大学运动队以及各级运动员

sentences.en: now hire sports psychologists to improve their game.
sentences.zh: 现在都会聘请运动心理学家来提升他们的竞技水平。

sentences.en: So what is sports psychology?
sentences.zh: 那么，什么是运动心理学？

sentences.en: How do sports psychologists work with athletes to improve their performance and their mental health?
sentences.zh: 运动心理学家如何与运动员合作以提升他们的表现和心理健康？

sentences.en: Is there a role for sports psychology outside elite athletics?
sentences.zh: 运动心理学在精英体育之外还有用武之地吗？

sentences.en: How does it relate to performance generally?
sentences.zh: 它与一般的表现有何关联？

sentences.en: And how might the discussion around athletes' mental health affect the perception of mental health in the United States and around the world?
sentences.zh: 围绕运动员心理健康的讨论，又将如何影响美国乃至全球对心理健康的认知？

sentences.en: Welcome to Speaking of Psychology, the flagship podcast of the American Psychological Association that examines the links between psychological science and everyday life.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听美国心理学会的旗舰播客《心理学谈话》，我们将探讨心理科学与日常生活之间的联系。

sentences.en: I'm Kim Mills.
sentences.zh: 我是金·米尔斯。

sentences.en: Our guest today is Dr. Jamie Shapiro, an associate professor and the co-director of the Masters in Sport and Performance Psychology program at the University of Denver.
sentences.zh: 我们今天的嘉宾是杰米·夏皮罗博士，她是丹佛大学运动与表现心理学硕士项目的副教授兼联合主任。

sentences.en: Dr. Shapiro is president of the Society for Sport, Exercise, and Performance Psychology, a division of APA.
sentences.zh: 夏皮罗博士是美国心理学会下属的运动、锻炼与表现心理学分会的主席。

sentences.en: She also works as a consultant with youth, collegiate, and elite athletes from a variety of sports, including gymnastics, skiing, snowboarding, soccer, and more.
sentences.zh: 她还担任各类运动项目（包括体操、滑雪、单板滑雪、足球等）的青少年、大学和精英运动员的顾问。

sentences.en: She has a particular interest in working with athletes with disabilities.
sentences.zh: 她对残疾运动员的心理辅导有着特别的兴趣。

sentences.en: In 2018, she traveled to Pyeongchang, South Korea, as a mental performance consultant for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 2018年，她曾作为心理表现顾问前往韩国平昌，

sentences.en: Paralympic team.
sentences.zh: 服务于美国残奥代表队。

sentences.en: As a former competitive gymnast and gymnastics coach, she understands from personal experience many of the challenges that athletes face.
sentences.zh: 作为一名前竞技体操运动员和体操教练，她从个人经历中深刻理解运动员所面临的许多挑战。

sentences.en: Thank you for joining us today, Dr. Shapiro.
sentences.zh: 感谢您今天参加我们的节目，夏皮罗博士。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我参加。

sentences.en: I'm honored.
sentences.zh: 我深感荣幸。

sentences.en: Let's start by talking broadly about what sports psychologists do.
sentences.zh: 让我们先从宏观层面谈谈运动心理学家是做什么的。

sentences.en: I mentioned two different things in the introduction, athletes' performance and their mental health.
sentences.zh: 我在介绍中提到了两件不同的事情：运动员的表现和他们的心理健康。

sentences.en: How are those two things related, and how do sports psychologists deal with both of them?
sentences.zh: 这两者是如何关联的？运动心理学家又是如何处理这两方面的？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So what I want people to know is that sports psychology isn't simply doing therapy with athletes.
sentences.zh: 我想让大家知道的是，运动心理学不仅仅是给运动员做心理治疗。

sentences.en: There's more to it, and a lot of that encompasses the mental performance that you mentioned.
sentences.zh: 它包含的内容更多，其中很大一部分涵盖了你提到的心理表现。

sentences.en: And so what we're trying to do with enhancing performance is helping athletes to perform consistently at the upper level of their capabilities,
sentences.zh: 我们致力于提升表现，旨在帮助运动员在能力范围内始终保持高水平发挥，

sentences.en: and we work on various mental skills to help them do that.
sentences.zh: 我们通过各种心理技能训练来帮助他们实现这一目标。

sentences.en: Everyone has mental health.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有心理健康。

sentences.en: It's on a continuum.
sentences.zh: 它处于一个连续谱上。

sentences.en: So we might say everyone has mental health.
sentences.zh: 所以我们可以说每个人都有心理健康。

sentences.en: Not everyone has mental illness.
sentences.zh: 但并非每个人都有心理疾病。

sentences.en: And then there's some places in between.
sentences.zh: 在这两者之间还有一些中间地带。

sentences.en: So there might be clinical mental health disorders where someone would fit the diagnostic criteria, for example, in the DSM-5.
sentences.zh: 比如，可能存在符合《精神疾病诊断与统计手册》第五版（DSM-5）诊断标准的临床心理健康障碍。

sentences.en: And then there could be subclinical mental health issues where someone is severely distressed, but maybe they don't fit the criteria for, say, depression, anxiety, OCD, etc.
sentences.zh: 也可能存在亚临床心理健康问题，即某人感到极度痛苦，但可能尚未达到抑郁、焦虑、强迫症等诊断标准。

sentences.en: And then there are just stressors of the human condition.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有人类生存状态中固有的压力源。

sentences.en: As you know, we all experience stress.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，我们每个人都会经历压力。

sentences.en: And then athletes experience specific stressors to their athletic realm.
sentences.zh: 而运动员在他们的竞技领域中还会经历特定的压力源。

sentences.en: And so people are trained in sports psychology also on a continuum where there are some people who are trained in that sports science.
sentences.zh: 因此，运动心理学领域的从业者受训背景也处于一个连续谱上，有些人受过运动科学方面的训练。

sentences.en: Some are trained in that mental performance aspect.
sentences.zh: 有些人则受过心理表现方面的训练。

sentences.en: And there's actually a certification called a certified mental performance consultant through the Association for Applied Sports Psychology.
sentences.zh: 事实上，应用运动心理学协会提供一种名为“认证心理表现顾问”的资格认证。

sentences.en: And those folks focus primarily on mental performance.
sentences.zh: 这些人主要专注于心理表现。

sentences.en: And then there are licensed mental health practitioners.
sentences.zh: 还有一些是持证心理健康从业者。

sentences.en: And some people have all of those credentials, and some people have one of those credentials.
sentences.zh: 有些人具备所有这些资质，而有些人只具备其中一种。

sentences.en: And so someone's education and training in this field would really help determine what they're competent ethically to work on with athletes and performers.
sentences.zh: 因此，一个人在该领域的教育和培训背景，将决定他们在职业道德范围内有能力为运动员和表演者提供哪些方面的帮助。

sentences.en: So someone like myself, I have a master's in counseling.
sentences.zh: 比如我本人，我拥有咨询硕士学位。

sentences.en: I'm a certified counselor, but I'm not a licensed mental health practitioner.
sentences.zh: 我是一名认证咨询师，但我不是持证心理健康从业者。

sentences.en: I am a certified mental performance consultant.
sentences.zh: 我是认证心理表现顾问。

sentences.en: And so the role with the teams and athletes that I work with is focusing on that mental performance, helping someone, you know, try to excel.
sentences.zh: 因此，我在与团队和运动员合作时的角色是专注于心理表现，帮助他们追求卓越。

sentences.en: They might have some anxieties or struggles in athletics.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会在竞技中遇到一些焦虑或困难。

sentences.en: So I'm trying to get them back to baseline.
sentences.zh: 所以我试图让他们恢复到基准水平。

sentences.en: But I'm really trying to get them to excel above what their baseline functioning was.
sentences.zh: 但我真正的目标是让他们超越原有的基准水平，实现卓越。

sentences.en: Whereas when we're thinking about mental health, or mental illness, or just some of those subclinical
sentences.zh: 而当我们考虑心理健康、心理疾病或是一些亚临床

sentences.en: issues, we're really trying to do some therapy to help someone get back to baseline.
sentences.zh: 问题时，我们确实需要进行一些治疗，以帮助他们恢复到基准水平。

sentences.en: So you could think of that continuum where are we trying to restore them to their baseline functioning where they were before the struggle?
sentences.zh: 你可以想象那个连续谱：我们是在试图让他们恢复到困境出现前的基准功能水平？

sentences.en: Or are we trying to get someone to excel above that baseline level?
sentences.zh: 还是在试图让他们超越那个基准水平？

sentences.en: So I get that you're working on the excel part.
sentences.zh: 我明白了，你主要致力于“超越”的部分。

sentences.en: But if an athlete also has some performance anxiety, I mean, can you counsel around that, even though you're not licensed in that area?
sentences.zh: 但如果运动员同时伴有某种表现焦虑，即使你没有该领域的执照，你也能进行心理辅导吗？

sentences.en: I mean, how do you stop yourself?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你如何把握界限？

sentences.en: You know how to do it.
sentences.zh: 你知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: So it's not just helping people excel.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅是帮助人们追求卓越。

sentences.en: I think I wanted to mention that because a lot of people think, well, if I'm working with a sports psychologist, or someone in the field, or a mental performance consultant,
sentences.zh: 我想提这一点，因为很多人认为，如果我正在与运动心理学家、该领域的专家或心理表现顾问合作，

sentences.en: there's something wrong with me.
sentences.zh: 那一定是我出了什么问题。

sentences.en: And that's not necessarily it.
sentences.zh: 事实并非一定如此。

sentences.en: There's this educational part where it's almost like coaching the mental aspect, we call it
sentences.zh: 这其中有一个教育环节，就像是针对心理层面的教练指导，我们称之为

sentences.en: consulting in our field, but consulting on the mental aspect, and nothing has to be wrong with you.
sentences.zh: 咨询，即针对心理层面的咨询，你并不一定非要有什么问题。

sentences.en: It could just be, we're helping you, you know, excel even more.
sentences.zh: 可能仅仅是为了帮助你，你知道，实现更大的突破。

sentences.en: However, of course, there are performance issues, or performance deficits, or anxiety, tons of performance anxiety, as you know.
sentences.zh: 当然，确实存在表现问题、表现缺陷或焦虑，如你所知，还有大量的表现焦虑。

sentences.en: And then so we are trying to get them back to baseline, and hopefully a little bit beyond.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，我们确实会试图让他们恢复到基准水平，并希望在此基础上更进一步。

sentences.en: But it doesn't mean we can't address these deficits.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着我们不能解决这些缺陷。

sentences.en: Just if it gets to that clinical point of those clinical disorders, we would want to refer to someone who's a licensed mental health provider.
sentences.zh: 只是如果达到了临床障碍的程度，我们就会建议转介给持证的心理健康提供者。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: That makes perfect sense.
sentences.zh: 这非常有道理。

sentences.en: So let's dig a little deeper into the mental performance aspect of sports psychology.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们深入探讨一下运动心理学中的心理表现方面。

sentences.en: How do sports psychologists work with athletes to help them prepare for competitions?
sentences.zh: 运动心理学家如何与运动员合作，帮助他们为比赛做准备？

sentences.en: What are the techniques that you use?
sentences.zh: 你们使用哪些技巧？

sentences.en: And are they different for different sports?
sentences.zh: 针对不同的运动项目，这些技巧会有所不同吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, and it's going to depend on someone's theoretical orientation, of course, but there are some cardinal mental skills that we work on in sports psychology.
sentences.zh: 是的，这当然取决于个人的理论取向，但在运动心理学中，我们确实会训练一些核心的心理技能。

sentences.en: And I'll give some examples of some of them.
sentences.zh: 我可以举几个例子。

sentences.en: I would say a lot of work we do is actually around self-awareness with athletes and helping them understand what works for you and what doesn't work for you.
sentences.zh: 我想说，我们所做的大量工作实际上是围绕运动员的自我意识，帮助他们了解什么对自己有效，什么无效。

sentences.en: And how do we build on those strengths?
sentences.zh: 以及我们如何利用这些优势？

sentences.en: So some of it is, you're the expert on yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以，某种程度上，你自己就是自己的专家。

sentences.en: How do you become aware of what works and keep using it?
sentences.zh: 你如何意识到什么有效并坚持使用？

sentences.en: Become aware of what's not working and tweak what you're doing to help those things that aren't working.
sentences.zh: 意识到什么无效，并调整你的做法来改善那些无效的部分。

sentences.en: So self-awareness is huge.
sentences.zh: 所以自我意识非常重要。

sentences.en: But some specific techniques, one, of course, is goal setting.
sentences.zh: 至于一些具体的技巧，首先当然是目标设定。

sentences.en: So we want someone to have specific goals.
sentences.zh: 我们希望运动员有明确的目标。

sentences.en: It helps direct your attention and your efforts.
sentences.zh: 这有助于引导你的注意力和努力方向。

sentences.en: And so we want goals to be good or effective goals.
sentences.zh: 我们希望目标是好的，或者说有效的目标。

sentences.en: I don't like the word good, but effective goals as we say.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢“好”这个词，我们通常说“有效的目标”。

sentences.en: So some people set goals.
sentences.zh: 有些人设定目标时会说：

sentences.en: I want to win, you know, and that's an outcome goal.
sentences.zh: “我想赢”，这是一种结果目标。

sentences.en: And that's good.
sentences.zh: 这很好。

sentences.en: And we want people to want to win and we want them to have goals beyond that.
sentences.zh: 我们希望人们有获胜的愿望，也希望他们有超越胜负的目标。

sentences.en: So I focus a lot with athletes on what I call process goals that aren't necessarily I want a podium or I want a certain number of medals or I want to win this game.
sentences.zh: 所以我经常与运动员关注我所谓的“过程目标”，这些目标不一定是我想要登上领奖台、获得多少奖牌或赢得这场比赛。

sentences.en: It's, well, okay, how do you make sure you do your best performance?
sentences.zh: 而是，好吧，你如何确保自己发挥出最佳水平？

sentences.en: And then the outcome is what it is.
sentences.zh: 至于结果，顺其自然。

sentences.en: Maybe you have a best performance and you still don't get that gold medal.
sentences.zh: 也许你发挥出了最佳水平，但依然没有拿到金牌。

sentences.en: And so we want athletes to still feel a sense of accomplishment, even if the outcome isn't what they want.
sentences.zh: 我们希望运动员即使在结果不如意时，依然能感受到成就感。

sentences.en: So we focus on, you know, what do you want to do along the way?
sentences.zh: 所以我们关注的是，你在此过程中想要做什么？

sentences.en: What are the processes or techniques you need to do in your sport in order to have your best performance?
sentences.zh: 为了发挥出最佳水平，你在运动中需要采取哪些过程或技巧？

sentences.en: So setting effective goals, and you've probably heard of SMART goals.
sentences.zh: 所以设定有效目标，你可能听说过SMART原则。

sentences.en: I know it's very catchy, but specific, measurable, you'll hear A very differently depending on the person.
sentences.zh: 我知道这很顺口，即具体、可衡量，而A（可达成）在不同人眼中会有很大差异。

sentences.en: I like adjustable because I think goals should be flexible, realistic, and time-based.
sentences.zh: 我更喜欢“可调整”，因为我认为目标应该是灵活的、现实的且有时限的。

sentences.en: So goal setting is one thing.
sentences.zh: 所以目标设定是一方面。

sentences.en: Of course, helping athletes with their motivation.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有帮助运动员管理动力。

sentences.en: Sometimes, obviously, motivation waxes and wanes.
sentences.zh: 显然，动力有时会起伏不定。

sentences.en: And so helping them connect to motivation so that they can have the most effective practice
sentences.zh: 因此，帮助他们建立动力，从而进行最有效的练习，

sentences.en: or we call deliberate practice where they're practicing with a purpose and getting the most out of their practice is important as well.
sentences.zh: 或者我们称之为“刻意练习”，即有目的地练习并从中获得最大收益，这也非常重要。

sentences.en: I would say arousal regulation.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是唤醒调节。

sentences.en: I like to use the term energy management because some athletes laugh at the word arousal, but
sentences.zh: 我喜欢用“能量管理”这个词，因为有些运动员听到“唤醒”这个词会笑，但

sentences.en: it's basically being aware of both physical and mental energy and how you're spending it.
sentences.zh: 它本质上是意识到你的生理和心理能量，以及你如何分配它们。

sentences.en: And so for this particular sport or event, do you want to be really hyped up and excited?
sentences.zh: 对于这项特定的运动或赛事，你是需要非常兴奋和亢奋吗？

sentences.en: Or do you need to be really relaxed and focused and helping athletes realize where they want to be,
sentences.zh: 还是需要非常放松和专注？帮助运动员意识到他们想要的状态，

sentences.en: but then giving them techniques such as deep breathing or relaxation or managing their self-talk to help get them to that level that they want to be at?
sentences.zh: 然后提供深呼吸、放松或管理自我对话等技巧，帮助他们达到理想水平？

sentences.en: And so I just mentioned self-talk.
sentences.zh: 刚才提到了自我对话。

sentences.en: I'm someone who focuses a lot on athlete self-talk.
sentences.zh: 我非常关注运动员的自我对话。

sentences.en: So I'm asking them what they're thinking, where is their mind?
sentences.zh: 我会问他们在想什么，他们的心思在哪里？

sentences.en: And is that, I like the word productive versus positive.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢用“富有成效”而不是“积极”这个词。

sentences.en: Is that productive for your performance?
sentences.zh: 这对你的表现有帮助吗？

sentences.en: So we talk a lot about what are your thoughts?
sentences.zh: 所以我们经常讨论你的想法是什么？

sentences.en: How is that affecting your performance, but also your well-being?
sentences.zh: 这不仅影响你的表现，也影响你的身心健康。

sentences.en: There's the counseling aspect of it in there as well.
sentences.zh: 这其中也包含了咨询的成分。

sentences.en: Focus and concentration is huge, especially during competition.
sentences.zh: 专注力和集中力非常重要，尤其是在比赛期间。

sentences.en: What are your focus cues?
sentences.zh: 你的专注线索是什么？

sentences.en: I help athletes develop simple focus cues to help keep them present and focused during their performance.
sentences.zh: 我帮助运动员制定简单的专注线索，以帮助他们在比赛中保持当下和专注。

sentences.en: And obviously at big games, Olympic games, Paralympic games, there's a lot of distractions.
sentences.zh: 显然，在大型赛事中，如奥运会、残奥会，有很多干扰因素。

sentences.en: It's a different environment maybe than they're used to.
sentences.zh: 环境可能与他们习惯的完全不同。

sentences.en: And so how can they still focus so that they could do what they're trained to do, despite all of that extra, what I call noise, in that environment that they're in.
sentences.zh: 那么，尽管环境中有我所谓的额外“噪音”，他们如何依然保持专注，从而完成他们训练的内容？

sentences.en: Routines are really important as well, although they should be flexible because things happen that people can't always predict, like a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 常规流程也非常重要，尽管它们应该是灵活的，因为总会发生一些无法预测的事情，比如大流行病。

sentences.en: But, you know, pre-race or pre-competition routines are something we work on to help an athlete feel really prepared and focused.
sentences.zh: 但是，赛前或赛前准备流程是我们努力的方向，以帮助运动员感到充分准备和专注。

sentences.en: And then I mentioned keywords, that's kind of the during performance routines, where do you want or where do you want your mind?
sentences.zh: 我还提到了关键词，这属于比赛过程中的流程，你想把心思放在哪里？

sentences.en: What do you want to be thinking?
sentences.zh: 你想思考什么？

sentences.en: And then also post-race or post-competition routines are important.
sentences.zh: 此外，赛后或比赛结束后的流程也很重要。

sentences.en: I think people think a lot about the pre and the during, but not the post-routines.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们更多关注赛前和比赛中，而忽略了赛后流程。

sentences.en: So what's your recovery like?
sentences.zh: 你的恢复情况如何？

sentences.en: And I'm also a big on reflection after training and after competition.
sentences.zh: 我也非常重视训练和比赛后的反思。

sentences.en: So I like athletes to think about what went well.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢让运动员思考哪些方面做得好。

sentences.en: Often they go right to what went wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们往往直接去想哪里做得不对。

sentences.en: So what went well and also what's worth improving for next time.
sentences.zh: 所以，哪些做得好，以及哪些值得在下次改进。

sentences.en: So it's a constant learning experience.
sentences.zh: 这是一个持续的学习过程。

sentences.en: Even if they didn't have the performance that they wanted, they could still learn something from it and still gain something from it.
sentences.zh: 即使他们没有达到预期的表现，依然可以从中学习并获得收获。

sentences.en: And so that way they don't feel like that was a complete waste or that was a complete failure.
sentences.zh: 这样他们就不会觉得之前的努力完全是浪费，或者是一次彻底的失败。

sentences.en: No, that didn't go the way you wanted.
sentences.zh: 不，虽然事情没有按你预想的发展。

sentences.en: You could always learn something from it that can help you improve for next time.
sentences.zh: 但你总能从中汲取经验，帮助你在下一次做得更好。

sentences.en: Um, in terms of team sports, I would say, so a lot of those are individual techniques, but we also work with groups and teaMs.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就团队运动而言，我想说，虽然很多都是个人技术，但我们也与小组和团队合作。

sentences.en: So team building, we want to build team cohesion so that people can work effectively with each other, working on communication,
sentences.zh: 在团队建设方面，我们希望建立团队凝聚力，让成员能够高效协作，改善沟通，

sentences.en: working on leadership for those who are leaders on the team.
sentences.zh: 并为团队中的领导者提供领导力培训。

sentences.en: And the same with coaches, we don't just work with athletes, we work with coaches on coaching education, and the coaches are the ones seeing the athletes all the time.
sentences.zh: 教练也是如此，我们不仅与运动员合作，还与教练进行执教教育，毕竟教练才是时刻陪伴运动员的人。

sentences.en: So I actually think it's even more effective to educate the coaches on how can you implement these mental skills with your athletes on a daily basis,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，教育教练如何将这些心理技能日常应用到运动员身上会更有效，

sentences.en: because that's how they're most effective is if they're consistently integrated.
sentences.zh: 因为只有持续整合，这些技能才能发挥最大作用。

sentences.en: So helping the leadership, whether that's coaches or leaders on a team, that leadership training is also something we work on recovery from injury mentally.
sentences.zh: 因此，无论是帮助教练还是团队领导者，这种领导力培训也是我们帮助运动员进行伤后心理康复的一部分。

sentences.en: So often, you know, there's, of course, the physical rehabilitation that athletes are doing.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，运动员当然会进行身体康复训练。

sentences.en: There's also a mental aspect of recovery and building that confidence again in the injured body part,
sentences.zh: 但康复过程中还有心理层面，需要重建对受伤部位的信心，

sentences.en: but also that they're able to do the skills that they were able to do pre-injury.
sentences.zh: 同时也要让他们恢复到伤前能够完成的技能水平。

sentences.en: These all sound really logical, like they would cut across all kinds of sports, whether you're a figure skater or a football player.
sentences.zh: 这些听起来很有逻辑，似乎适用于各种运动，无论是花样滑冰还是橄榄球。

sentences.en: I mean, there are commonalities.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它们确实有共同点。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And I would say in terms of differences between sports, they can be applicable to all sports, but different sports have different needs.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，虽然这些方法适用于所有运动，但不同运动有不同的需求。

sentences.en: They have different cultures.
sentences.zh: 它们有不同的文化。

sentences.en: They have different languages.
sentences.zh: 它们有不同的术语。

sentences.en: And so it would be important for the sports psychology professional to assess what are the needs of this particular team.
sentences.zh: 因此，运动心理学专家评估特定团队的需求至关重要。

sentences.en: And that's going to be different for everyone.
sentences.zh: 这对每个人来说都是不同的。

sentences.en: Or what are the needs of this particular individual?
sentences.zh: 或者评估这个特定个人的需求是什么？

sentences.en: And of course, we can't be experts on all sports.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们不可能成为所有运动的专家。

sentences.en: I did gymnastics most of my life, so I know the language really well.
sentences.zh: 我大半辈子都在练体操，所以我非常熟悉那里的术语。

sentences.en: But I work mostly now with Paralympic athletes, and I did not know much about most of these sports.
sentences.zh: 但我现在主要与残奥会运动员合作，而我对其中大多数运动了解并不多。

sentences.en: So from observation, from videos, from talking to my athletes, you know, they're the expert on their sport.
sentences.zh: 所以通过观察、看视频、与运动员交谈，你知道，他们才是自己运动项目的专家。

sentences.en: I'm the expert on the mental skills.
sentences.zh: 而我是心理技能方面的专家。

sentences.en: And so it's a collaborative effort.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一项协作工作。

sentences.en: We work together in order to work on and address their mental performance.
sentences.zh: 我们共同努力，去解决他们的心理表现问题。

sentences.en: But it is important for the professional to learn, again, the culture, the language of the particular performance area that they're working in.
sentences.zh: 但对于专业人士来说，学习他们所处领域的文化和术语依然很重要。

sentences.en: Well, speaking of terms, one of the terms I think we learned during the Olympics was the twisties, right, which affected Simone Biles.
sentences.zh: 说到术语，我想我们在奥运会期间学到的一个词是“扭转障碍”（twisties），对吧？西蒙·拜尔斯就受此影响。

sentences.en: And in other sports, something very similar to that is called the yips.
sentences.zh: 在其他运动中，非常类似的情况被称为“易普症”（yips）。

sentences.en: So what is happening when athletes experience this?
sentences.zh: 那么，当运动员经历这些时，到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: Why does it happen?
sentences.zh: 为什么会发生这种情况？

sentences.en: And what can sports psychologists do to help people work through them?
sentences.zh: 运动心理学家能做些什么来帮助他们克服这些障碍？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: So I call it a mental block in gymnastics.
sentences.zh: 在体操中，我称之为心理阻滞。

sentences.en: The twisties, I had actually never heard the term before Nastia Lukin used it on NBC and made it go viral.
sentences.zh: “扭转障碍”这个词，在娜斯佳·柳金在NBC使用并使其走红之前，我其实从未听说过。

sentences.en: But the twisties are a specific form of a mental block for twisting skills.
sentences.zh: 但“扭转障碍”是针对转体动作的一种特定形式的心理阻滞。

sentences.en: But there could be other mental blocks in gymnastics.
sentences.zh: 体操中也可能存在其他心理阻滞。

sentences.en: I've seen it with many teammates where all of a sudden they just can't tumble backwards.
sentences.zh: 我见过很多队友突然就无法完成向后翻腾动作了。

sentences.en: And it's something they've been doing for years and years.
sentences.zh: 而这明明是他们做了多年、非常熟练的动作。

sentences.en: I would have something on the balance beam where I just couldn't get my body to go backwards sometimes.
sentences.zh: 我在平衡木上也遇到过这种情况，有时就是无法让身体向后运动。

sentences.en: So it's very common.
sentences.zh: 所以这非常普遍。

sentences.en: I want to put that out there.
sentences.zh: 我想强调这一点。

sentences.en: And then in other sports, the yips where, say, a pitcher all of a sudden can't throw a ball to where they want it to go happens in golf.
sentences.zh: 在其他运动中，比如高尔夫球，投手突然无法将球投到想要的位置，这就是“易普症”。

sentences.en: And it seems bizarre, right?
sentences.zh: 这看起来很离奇，对吧？

sentences.en: Like how can someone all of a sudden not be able to do something they've been able to do for many years?
sentences.zh: 一个人怎么可能突然无法完成做了多年的动作呢？

sentences.en: And I'm not going to pretend to understand all the psychophysiology behind it.
sentences.zh: 我不会假装了解其背后的所有心理生理学机制。

sentences.en: There are some physical theories.
sentences.zh: 有一些生理学理论。

sentences.en: There's something called focal dystonia where it's a neurological condition, they say, where your muscles are overworked.
sentences.zh: 有一种被称为“局灶性肌张力障碍”的神经系统疾病，据说是因为肌肉过度劳累。

sentences.en: And so all of a sudden they just stop working.
sentences.zh: 所以它们突然就停止工作了。

sentences.en: But what I would simplify it to is there's a disconnect between the brain and body where the brain, for some reason,
sentences.zh: 但我会将其简化为大脑和身体之间的脱节，即大脑出于某种原因，

sentences.en: is not accessing the motor programs that are stored there for specific skills.
sentences.zh: 无法调用存储在那里用于特定技能的运动程序。

sentences.en: And also just getting a little bit more into the neuroscience.
sentences.zh: 再深入一点谈谈神经科学。

sentences.en: Again, this is not my area of expertise.
sentences.zh: 再次声明，这不是我的专业领域。

sentences.en: But when there's a fight response, when we're stressed, our cerebellum kicks in.
sentences.zh: 但当我们感到压力、产生战斗反应时，小脑就会介入。

sentences.en: That's our survival mode.
sentences.zh: 那是我们的生存模式。

sentences.en: And so that's the dominant part of the brain that's working and not the cerebrum where higher order functions are and things like logical thought and motor prograMs.
sentences.zh: 所以那是大脑中主导工作的区域，而不是负责高级功能、逻辑思维和运动程序的大脑皮层。

sentences.en: And so there's just a disconnect between the cerebrum and the cerebellum as well as brain and body.
sentences.zh: 因此，大脑皮层和小脑之间，以及大脑和身体之间出现了脱节。

sentences.en: So that's what's really going on, what I would say and what I've seen.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所看到的，也是我认为真正发生的事情。

sentences.en: And I can't speak for Simone Biles.
sentences.zh: 我不能代表西蒙·拜尔斯发言。

sentences.en: I don't know her and I'm not going to pretend to understand what was going on with her.
sentences.zh: 我不认识她，也不会假装了解她身上发生了什么。

sentences.en: But just in general, in terms of mental blocks, sometimes they come out of the blue.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，心理阻滞有时会毫无征兆地出现。

sentences.en: And I did see an interview with Simone where she said, I thought it was just a fluke.
sentences.zh: 我确实看过西蒙的一次采访，她说，我以为这只是个意外。

sentences.en: Like I just lost my sense, her proprioception or her sense of where she was in the air.
sentences.zh: 就像我失去了感觉，失去了本体感觉，或者失去了对自己在空中位置的感知。

sentences.en: She thought it was weird.
sentences.zh: 她觉得这很奇怪。

sentences.en: And she's like, let me just do it tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 她说，让我明天再试一次。

sentences.en: She came back and it happened again.
sentences.zh: 她回来后，同样的情况又发生了。

sentences.en: And so that's really common where it's like, oh, that's weird.
sentences.zh: 这种情况很常见，起初觉得“哦，真奇怪”。

sentences.en: And then it happens again and then it happens again.
sentences.zh: 然后它再次发生，接着又发生。

sentences.en: And then it just exacerbates and gets worse.
sentences.zh: 然后情况就会加剧，变得更糟。

sentences.en: And stress does all sorts of things to our body, which do not help our performance, especially as an athlete.
sentences.zh: 压力会对我们的身体产生各种影响，这对运动员的表现毫无帮助。

sentences.en: And so the more the mental block happens, the more stress we get and the less we're able to access that part of the brain and body that knows what to do.
sentences.zh: 所以心理阻滞发生得越多，我们的压力就越大，就越难调用大脑和身体中那些知道该怎么做的部分。

sentences.en: How does your own background as a competitive gymnast influence your approach to helping athletes?
sentences.zh: 作为一名竞技体操运动员的背景，如何影响你帮助运动员的方法？

sentences.en: No, I think I can relate a bit to what athletes are going to have compassion for them.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为我能对运动员的感受产生共鸣，并对他们抱有同情心。

sentences.en: I could think of things that worked for me, but I, you know, I've studied this for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我能想到对我有效的方法，但我研究这个领域已经很久了。

sentences.en: So it's not just about what works for me as an athlete.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅是关于什么对我作为运动员有效。

sentences.en: That wouldn't make me a professional.
sentences.zh: 那并不能让我成为一名专业人士。

sentences.en: That would make me a former athlete trying to help athletes.
sentences.zh: 那只会让我成为一个试图帮助运动员的前运动员。

sentences.en: So, but it is helpful to think back and reflect on what worked for me and what didn't, but also know different things work for different people.
sentences.zh: 所以，回顾并反思什么对我有效、什么无效是有帮助的，但也要知道不同的人需要不同的方法。

sentences.en: So I really, if I'm working with a gymnast,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我正在与一名体操运动员合作，

sentences.en: I need to check myself because I have so much bias as a former athlete and as a coach that I have to be careful to keep that mental performance hat on versus jump into coach mode,
sentences.zh: 我需要自我审视，因为作为前运动员和教练，我有太多的偏见，我必须小心保持“心理表现顾问”的身份，而不是跳进“教练模式”，

sentences.en: things like that.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: So it's actually easier for me to work with sports that I'm not as familiar with because I can really stay in my lane and focus on mental performance.
sentences.zh: 所以，与我不那么熟悉的运动项目合作反而更容易，因为我可以坚守本职，专注于心理表现。

sentences.en: But it's also helpful to work with gymnasts because I do understand what they're going through and understand the language and the culture of the sport.
sentences.zh: 但与体操运动员合作也很有帮助，因为我确实理解他们的经历，也理解这项运动的语言和文化。

sentences.en: So I can think of maybe what would have been helpful for me as an athlete.
sentences.zh: 所以我可以想到作为运动员时，什么可能对我有所帮助。

sentences.en: I didn't have sports psychology services even through college as a college athlete.
sentences.zh: 我上大学时，即使作为校队运动员，也没有运动心理学服务。

sentences.en: I did have a coach who was very psychologically minded and would talk to us a lot about these topics and not call it sports psychology.
sentences.zh: 我确实有一位非常有心理学头脑的教练，他经常和我们谈论这些话题，只是不称其为运动心理学。

sentences.en: But now looking back, I know that's what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 但现在回想起来，我知道他当时就是在做这些。

sentences.en: And I think that's ultimately why I had an interest in all of this because I found it really fascinating.
sentences.zh: 我想这最终是我对这一切产生兴趣的原因，因为我发现它真的很迷人。

sentences.en: And fear is a big part of gymnastics.
sentences.zh: 恐惧是体操的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: So understanding that fear and how to work through that is really important.
sentences.zh: 所以理解那种恐惧以及如何克服它非常重要。

sentences.en: But I think being a mental performance consultant and having been an athlete in this role,
sentences.zh: 但我觉得作为一名心理表现顾问，同时又曾是运动员，

sentences.en: I'm one of the few people in an athlete's life that I don't want to say doesn't care about the outcome, but that's not the only thing I care about.
sentences.zh: 我是运动员生命中为数不多的人之一——我不想说我不关心结果，但那不是我唯一关心的事情。

sentences.en: And I do care about their well-being and themselves as a whole person, not just an athlete.
sentences.zh: 我确实关心他们的幸福，关心他们作为一个完整的人，而不仅仅是一名运动员。

sentences.en: And so even when I work with my Paralympic athletes, I say, you know, I don't care if you medal.
sentences.zh: 所以即使在与残奥会运动员合作时，我也会说，你知道，我不在乎你是否获得奖牌。

sentences.en: I'm like, I care because you care, of course.
sentences.zh: 我说，当然，因为你在乎，所以我也会在乎。

sentences.en: And I'm going to be here to support you no matter what happens.
sentences.zh: 无论发生什么，我都会在这里支持你。

sentences.en: And that's a relief to them because a lot of people in the system, their jobs depend on medals.
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说是一种解脱，因为在体制内，很多人的工作都依赖于奖牌。

sentences.en: I don't think mine does.
sentences.zh: 我不认为我的工作是这样。

sentences.en: And if it does, I probably don't want to be in that system.
sentences.zh: 如果真是这样，我可能不想待在那个体制里。

sentences.en: I do want to help them again achieve their beSt.
sentences.zh: 我确实想再次帮助他们实现最佳状态。

sentences.en: But I, you know, I think it's a comfort to them knowing that someone in my role is there to help them and support them no matter what.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，知道有一个像我这样角色的人在支持他们，无论发生什么都会帮助他们，这对他们来说是一种安慰。

sentences.en: And I'm not saying coaches aren't, parents aren't, but I hope that they feel that.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说教练或父母不关心，但我希望他们能感受到这一点。

sentences.en: And me being a former athlete, I think that support, no matter what the outcome, is comforting and hopefully helpful to them.
sentences.zh: 而作为一名曾经的运动员，我认为无论结果如何，这种支持都是令人欣慰的，希望对他们也有所帮助。

sentences.en: So let me ask you, how is sports psychology related to performance in other realms?
sentences.zh: 那么请问，运动心理学与其他领域的表现有何关联？

sentences.en: Say I'm a CEO about to oversee my first shareholder meeting and I'm terrified of making a mistake
sentences.zh: 假设我是一位即将主持第一次股东大会的CEO，我非常害怕犯错，

sentences.en: or I'm a concert pianist and I've suddenly forgotten how to play a Rachmaninoff concerto, right?
sentences.zh: 或者我是一位音乐会钢琴家，突然忘记了如何演奏拉赫玛尼诺夫的协奏曲，对吧？

sentences.en: That I have to perform in concert.
sentences.zh: 而我必须在音乐会上表演。

sentences.en: I mean, how does a performance psychologist help in those areas?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，表现心理学家如何帮助这些领域的人？

sentences.en: And that's what we say.
sentences.zh: 我们就是这么说的。

sentences.en: I think the broader field should actually be called performance psychology and sports psychology should be under that umbrella.
sentences.zh: 我认为更广泛的领域实际上应该被称为“表现心理学”，而运动心理学应该归于其下。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, it's like performance psychology is different than sports psych, but sport falls
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，表现心理学与运动心理学被分开了，但运动属于表现，

sentences.en: under performance, business falls under performance, as you mentioned, performing arts.
sentences.zh: 商业属于表现，正如你提到的，表演艺术也属于表现。

sentences.en: And also a large part of our field now is what we call high-risk occupations, including military,
sentences.zh: 此外，我们领域现在很大一部分是所谓的“高风险职业”，包括军队、

sentences.en: firefighting, police, obviously those high-stress jobs, which have similar issues that we've been talking about and similar skills can be helpful in all those domains.
sentences.zh: 消防、警察，显然这些高压工作有着我们一直在讨论的类似问题，类似的技能在所有这些领域都有帮助。

sentences.en: So again, if someone forgets how to play a piece or has stage fright, I think that's another psychological thing that many performers talk about.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果有人忘记了如何演奏曲目或有舞台恐惧症，我认为这是许多表演者都会谈论的另一种心理问题。

sentences.en: We could do some of the same techniques that we would do with athletes specifically, you know, you have to rebuild someone's confidence.
sentences.zh: 我们可以使用与运动员相同的技术，你知道，你必须重建一个人的信心。

sentences.en: So start with basics.
sentences.zh: 所以从基础开始。

sentences.en: So they suddenly forget to play.
sentences.zh: 他们突然忘记了如何演奏。

sentences.en: Let's go back to basics.
sentences.zh: 让我们回到基础。

sentences.en: Let's build up the skill and the muscle memory.
sentences.zh: 让我们建立技能和肌肉记忆。

sentences.en: And it should happen quicker because it's there somewhere, but you basically start from the beginning and gradually increase the performance until they can get it back.
sentences.zh: 这应该会很快，因为它还在某处，但你基本上是从头开始，逐渐增加表现难度，直到他们能找回状态。

sentences.en: And it would be similar with gymnastics or diving or any other sport where it's like, got to
sentences.zh: 这与体操、跳水或任何其他运动类似，就像是必须

sentences.en: go back and kind of relearn it from the beginning and then slowly build that confidence that they can do it again.
sentences.zh: 回到原点，从头开始重新学习，然后慢慢建立起他们能再次做到的信心。

sentences.en: I would say another technique to help with mental blocks, no matter what the performance area
sentences.zh: 我想说，无论在哪个表现领域，帮助克服心理阻滞的另一种技术

sentences.en: would be if someone could watch video of themselves doing it successfully, or in the case of a musician, listening to it and doing imagery at the same time.
sentences.zh: 是观看自己成功完成动作的视频，或者对于音乐家来说，一边听音乐一边进行意象训练。

sentences.en: So kind of feeling themselves playing that piece, imagining where they're pressing the keys or feeling their body go through a twisting movement as they're watching the video.
sentences.zh: 感受自己演奏那段乐曲，想象按键的位置，或者在观看视频时感受身体完成转体动作的过程。

sentences.en: And again, we're just trying to reconnect that brain-body connection that's missing.
sentences.zh: 我们只是在尝试重新连接缺失的大脑与身体之间的联系。

sentences.en: In terms of a business professional who's nervous or scared of making a mistake, it would be using
sentences.zh: 对于一个紧张或害怕犯错的商业专业人士来说，可以使用

sentences.en: similar confidence-building skills, maybe again, doing imagery, helping them with that arousal
sentences.zh: 类似的信心建立技能，也许再次进行意象训练，帮助他们进行唤醒水平的

sentences.en: regulation of like, what's your pre-performance routine when you're speaking to your employees or whatever it might be.
sentences.zh: 调节，比如你在向员工讲话或做其他事情之前的表现前准备程序是什么。

sentences.en: So it's not just like, get up there and talk.
sentences.zh: 所以不仅仅是“站上去讲”那么简单。

sentences.en: No, there could be a pre-performance routine for that.
sentences.zh: 不，那也可以有表现前的准备程序。

sentences.en: I know I'm a professor, so I have to teach and I try to do some things to help prepare before I go teach.
sentences.zh: 我知道我是一名教授，所以我必须教学，我会在去教学之前尝试做一些事情来帮助自己准备。

sentences.en: Teachings, performance, psychology, any sort of public speaking.
sentences.zh: 教学、表现、心理学、任何形式的公开演讲。

sentences.en: And obviously, many people struggle with public speaking.
sentences.zh: 显然，许多人在公开演讲方面都有困难。

sentences.en: So having those routines, practicing, getting feedback, video imagery are just a few things that can help in multiple performance areas.
sentences.zh: 所以拥有这些程序、练习、获取反馈、视频意象训练，只是可以在多个表现领域提供帮助的几种方法。

sentences.en: And of course, the stress management, the arousal regulation also just applies across many performance areas.
sentences.zh: 当然，压力管理和唤醒调节也同样适用于许多表现领域。

sentences.en: So as we've said a couple of times, you work with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 正如我们已经提到过几次的，你与美国

sentences.en: Paralympic team.
sentences.zh: 残奥会代表队合作。

sentences.en: Can you tell us more about that work and how you got involved in it?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们更多关于那项工作以及你是如何参与其中的吗？

sentences.en: And what are the special considerations when you're working with athletes with disabilities?
sentences.zh: 在与残疾运动员合作时，有哪些特殊的考虑因素？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I'm so happy to talk about Paralympic.
sentences.zh: 我非常乐意谈论残奥会。

sentences.en: Athletes of Paralympics are coming up August 24th to September 5th, and they're getting more TV coverage than ever.
sentences.zh: 残奥会将于8月24日至9月5日举行，他们获得的电视报道比以往任何时候都多。

sentences.en: So I hope people check that out.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望大家能关注一下。

sentences.en: But I actually didn't have much training in working with athletes with disabilities during my graduate training.
sentences.zh: 但我实际上在研究生培训期间并没有太多与残疾运动员合作的培训。

sentences.en: I had some classmates who did it.
sentences.zh: 我有一些同学做过。

sentences.en: And then as a supervisor of students here at the University of Denver, I had some students actually working with athletes with disabilities.
sentences.zh: 后来，作为丹佛大学的学生导师，我确实有一些学生在与残疾运动员一起工作。

sentences.en: But this opportunity kind of fell in my lap from being in Denver that some of the sports psychologists at the USOPC, you know, they couldn't manage all the sports and all the
sentences.zh: 但这个机会某种程度上是主动找上门来的，因为我在丹佛，而美国奥委会（USOPC）的一些运动心理学家，你知道，他们无法管理所有的运动项目和所有的

sentences.en: Paralympic athletes and the high performance director of Paralympics at the time recognized that they needed more sports psychology support.
sentences.zh: 残奥会运动员，当时的残奥会高水平表现总监意识到他们需要更多的运动心理支持。

sentences.en: So they reached out to myself and some of my colleagues here at the University of Denver and said, will you meet with us?
sentences.zh: 所以他们联系了我以及我在丹佛大学的一些同事，问我愿不愿意和他们见个面？

sentences.en: We want more support.
sentences.zh: 我们需要更多的支持。

sentences.en: And so we met for coffee and I always tell students, take the coffee meeting, see where it goes.
sentences.zh: 于是我们约了喝咖啡，我总是告诉学生，接受咖啡邀约，看看会有什么进展。

sentences.en: It may go nowhere.
sentences.zh: 可能什么也不会发生。

sentences.en: It may go somewhere.
sentences.zh: 也可能会有所收获。

sentences.en: For me, it changed my career.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这改变了我的职业生涯。

sentences.en: I've been, you know, working with Paralympic athletes since 2014.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我从2014年就开始与残奥会运动员合作了。

sentences.en: After that coffee meeting, we got connected with some coaches and my colleague Artura Poshfordoski
sentences.zh: 在那次咖啡会谈之后，我们与一些教练取得了联系，我的同事阿图拉·波什福多斯基（Artura Poshfordoski）

sentences.en: and I, we work a lot together with several teams as well as individually with teams and athletes.
sentences.zh: 和我，我们经常一起与多个团队合作，也会单独为团队和运动员提供服务。

sentences.en: And so it took off from there.
sentences.zh: 事情就是从那时开始起步的。

sentences.en: And like I said, it's changed my career.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，这改变了我的职业生涯。

sentences.en: I've been able to present on it and bring more attention to work with athletes with disabilities.
sentences.zh: 我有机会就此进行演讲，并让人们更加关注残疾运动员的工作。

sentences.en: So we go to training camps, some competitions.
sentences.zh: 所以我们会去训练营，参加一些比赛。

sentences.en: I do a lot of distance consulting.
sentences.zh: 我做了很多远程咨询。

sentences.en: So when the pandemic happened and people had to do this tele-consulting or tele-therapy, I was quite used to it because the athletes I work with are all over the country.
sentences.zh: 所以当疫情发生，人们不得不进行远程咨询或远程治疗时，我已经相当习惯了，因为我合作的运动员遍布全国。

sentences.en: And so we did a lot of that video consulting already, although I haven't seen them in longer than I ever have.
sentences.zh: 所以我们已经做了很多视频咨询，尽管我见到他们的时间比以往任何时候都要长。

sentences.en: So that's a little bit strange, but I'm also supporting them remotely while they're in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 这有点奇怪，但当他们在东京时，我也在远程支持他们。

sentences.en: And it doesn't, aside from the large time change, it doesn't feel strange at all to talk to them through a computer.
sentences.zh: 除了巨大的时差之外，通过电脑与他们交谈一点也不觉得奇怪。

sentences.en: But, you know, we do some of the skills that I already mentioned, you know, goal setting
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我们确实会运用我之前提到的一些技能，比如目标设定，

sentences.en: arousal regulations, certainly with the games coming up, just talking about what that environment
sentences.zh: 唤醒调节，当然随着比赛临近，只是谈论比赛环境可能会是什么样，

sentences.en: might be like at the games, how to manage those stressors or distractions that are specific to a game's environment.
sentences.zh: 如何管理那些比赛环境特有的压力源或干扰因素。

sentences.en: And I always talk to them about like, if you can just execute the plan that you've been training to do for those few minutes or a few hours of your life, depending on the
sentences.zh: 我总是对他们说，如果你能执行你已经训练了的那几分钟或几小时的计划，具体取决于你的运动项目，

sentences.en: sport, then the outcome is what it is.
sentences.zh: 那么结果就是那样了。

sentences.en: And that's so much easier said than done.
sentences.zh: 说起来容易做起来难。

sentences.en: But we work, what are your plans?
sentences.zh: 但我们确实在研究，你的计划是什么？

sentences.en: Again, the pre-competition plans, what are your cues for during the competition?
sentences.zh: 再说一次，赛前计划，你在比赛期间的提示语是什么？

sentences.en: What are you going to do afterwards to reflect?
sentences.zh: 赛后你打算做什么来反思？

sentences.en: And if you can get to that, that you've been training, and that's what we call it, mental training.
sentences.zh: 如果你能做到这一点，也就是你一直在训练的内容，这就是我们所说的心理训练。

sentences.en: It's not like, well, I'm going to meet with you, teach you imagery, and then it's magic.
sentences.zh: 这不像说，好吧，我要和你见面，教你意象训练，然后就产生魔法了。

sentences.en: It's things that should be integrated consistently and trained consistently.
sentences.zh: 这些事情应该持续整合并持续训练。

sentences.en: And that's when it makes a difference.
sentences.zh: 只有这样才能产生影响。

sentences.en: Just, I don't think I've mentioned this.
sentences.zh: 只是，我不确定我是否提到过这一点。

sentences.en: Another big part of my philosophy in theory and many professionals in our field is the relationship aspect, I call it client-centered or student-centered or person-centered, where
sentences.zh: 我的理论哲学以及我们领域许多专业人士的另一个重要部分是关系层面，我称之为以客户为中心、以学生为中心或以人为中心，即

sentences.en: I am showing care for them as a whole athlete and not just talking to them as an athlete, but what is going on in your life that could be affecting performance and just supporting
sentences.zh: 我作为一个整体来关心他们，不仅仅是作为运动员与他们交谈，而是了解你生活中发生了什么可能影响表现的事情，并仅仅作为一个人来支持他们。

sentences.en: them as a whole person.
sentences.zh: 支持他们作为一个完整的人。

sentences.en: But that rapport building, we call it, or relationship building, I think is an essential foundation before just jumping into skills that they could use.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，这种我们称之为建立融洽关系或建立关系的过程，是在直接使用技能之前必不可少的基础。

sentences.en: And if you don't have that trust and relationship from clients, and this is general, this is
sentences.zh: 如果你没有从客户那里获得那种信任和关系，这是普遍的，这是

sentences.en: Counseling 101, but if you don't have that rapport, any fancy techniques or skills that you throw at them is not necessarily going to be effective.
sentences.zh: 咨询入门知识，但如果你没有那种融洽的关系，你扔给他们的任何花哨的技术或技能都不一定会有效。

sentences.en: And so what's been great with Paralympic athletes is I've worked with them for a number of years,
sentences.zh: 所以与残奥会运动员合作很棒的一点是，我已经与他们合作多年了，

sentences.en: and we've built that trust and relationship so that hopefully they are integrating the things that we're talking about and they become effective, hopefully.
sentences.zh: 我们已经建立了那种信任和关系，希望他们能整合我们讨论的内容，并希望它们能发挥作用。

sentences.en: Have you seen an increase in recent years in interest from professional and collegiate sports leagues and teams in working with sports psychologists?
sentences.zh: 近年来，你是否看到职业和大学体育联盟及团队对与运动心理学家合作的兴趣有所增加？

sentences.en: I believe so.
sentences.zh: 我相信是这样的。

sentences.en: And we have students, and so I hope there are more and more jobs from them.
sentences.zh: 我们有学生，所以我希望他们能有越来越多的工作机会。

sentences.en: But there are certain, certainly organizations have increased their resources here.
sentences.zh: 但确实，组织机构肯定增加了这方面的资源。

sentences.en: And I would say, especially with that mental health, the USOPC now added a mental health director who happens to be one of my good friends and colleagues, Dr. Jessica Bartley,
sentences.zh: 我想说，特别是在心理健康方面，美国奥委会现在增加了一位心理健康总监，她恰好是我的好朋友和同事，杰西卡·巴特利（Dr. Jessica Bartley）博士，

sentences.en: and she hired a fantastic staff.
sentences.zh: 她聘请了一支很棒的团队。

sentences.en: So they basically added a whole new department for mental health.
sentences.zh: 所以他们基本上增加了一个全新的心理健康部门。

sentences.en: They already had sports psychologists who focus on mental performance, but also mental health.
sentences.zh: 他们已经有了专注于心理表现的运动心理学家，但现在也关注心理健康。

sentences.en: And they realized, you know what, we need some more extra support for this mental health aspect, especially with so many athletes speaking out about it.
sentences.zh: 他们意识到，你知道吗，我们需要在心理健康方面提供额外的支持，特别是有这么多运动员公开谈论这个问题。

sentences.en: And then other professional organizations such as the NFL also now require every team to have a licensed mental health professional on staff.
sentences.zh: 然后其他职业组织，如NFL，现在也要求每个团队必须配备一名持证心理健康专业人员。

sentences.en: And so that's been, you know, it's increased jobs in the field, but that's been wonderful to see in terms of support for the athletes.
sentences.zh: 所以这增加了该领域的工作岗位，但在运动员支持方面，看到这一点真是太好了。

sentences.en: And I don't think colleges require a licensed mental health professional to be embedded in athletics, but we are seeing more and more departments as a result of some of the studies
sentences.zh: 我不认为大学要求必须在体育部门中嵌入持证心理健康专业人员，但由于NCAA进行的一些研究，我们确实看到越来越多的部门增加了他们的心理健康和心理表现人员。

sentences.en: that the NCAA has done increase their mental health and mental performance staff.
sentences.zh: 这很有道理。

sentences.en: That makes sense.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当然如果你看到了结果，那本身就非常有说服力。

sentences.en: I mean, certainly if you see results, that speaks very loudly.
sentences.zh: 我在介绍中简要谈到了过去一年媒体对运动员心理健康的巨大关注。

sentences.en: I spoke a little bit in the introduction about the tremendous media focus on athletes' mental health in the past year.
sentences.zh: 你认为为什么现在会发生这种情况？

sentences.en: Why do you think this is happening now?
sentences.zh: 为什么运动员可能会感到更有力量去坦诚地谈论他们运动中的心理层面以及他们整体的心理健康？

sentences.en: Why might athletes feel more empowered to talk candidly about the mental aspects of their sports and about their mental health generally?
sentences.zh: 我不确定这是否是新现象。

sentences.en: And I'm not sure it's so new.
sentences.zh: 我认为运动员一直都在谈论这个问题。

sentences.en: I think athletes have been speaking out about this.
sentences.zh: 有博客。

sentences.en: There have been blogs.
sentences.zh: 有采访。

sentences.en: There have been interviews.
sentences.zh: 我认为这些非常著名的运动员已经站出来谈论过这个问题。

sentences.en: I think these really prominent athletes have come out and spoken about this.
sentences.zh: 还有一部纪录片《金牌的重量》（The Weight of Gold），许多奥运会或残奥会运动员谈到了运动员所经历的心理健康挣扎。

sentences.en: And there was a documentary, The Weight of Gold, that many Olympic or Paralympic athletes spoke out about the mental health struggles that athletes go through.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为通过纪录片、博客、采访这些媒介，更多的运动员正在公开谈论这个问题。

sentences.en: And so I think through these mediums of documentaries, of blogs, of interviews, that more athletes are speaking out about this.
sentences.zh: 他们看到了其他运动员的榜样作用，并说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And they're seeing this modeling from other athletes and saying, you know what?
sentences.zh: 我也在为此挣扎。

sentences.en: I struggle with that too.
sentences.zh: 我认为讨论这个问题很重要，这样人们就不会感到羞耻，或者觉得有什么不对劲，

sentences.en: And I think it's important to discuss this so that people don't feel ashamed or like something's
sentences.zh: 并希望他们能寻求帮助，知道自己并不孤单。

sentences.en: wrong with them and that they do hopefully seek help and know that they're not alone.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是认为越来越多的知名运动员站出来披露他们的一些心理健康挣扎。

sentences.en: So I just think more and more of these prominent athletes are coming out and disclosing some of their mental health struggles.
sentences.zh: 我希望这能渗透到青少年层面，让他们看到，哦，那位运动员在挣扎，我也在挣扎。

sentences.en: And I hope that trickles down to the youth levels where they see, oh, that athlete struggled and I'm struggling too.
sentences.zh: 那么我该去哪里寻求帮助呢？

sentences.en: And so where do I go for help?
sentences.zh: 希望他们生活中的某个人能将他们与所需的资源联系起来。

sentences.en: And hopefully someone in their life can connect them to the resources they need.
sentences.zh: 如果是心理表现问题，就去找受过相关训练的人。

sentences.en: If it's more of a mental performance issue, going to people trained in that.
sentences.zh: 如果是心理健康问题或精神疾病，就去找持证心理健康专业人员。

sentences.en: And if it's more of a mental health issue or mental illness, going to a licensed mental health professional.

sentences.en: So in watching what happened with Simone Biles and Naomi Osaka, my impression from what I saw
sentences.zh: 而西蒙·拜尔斯，大家似乎都理解。

sentences.en: read was that they were treated very differently in the mind of the public, that somehow Naomi
sentences.zh: 哦，你知道，她是史上最伟大的运动员。

sentences.en: Osaka was seen as more of, you know, prima donna with a problem that people didn't understand.
sentences.zh: 难怪她会对那些她能做的事情感到恐惧。

sentences.en: And Simone Biles, everybody kind of got that.
sentences.zh: 但这也是你的解读吗？

sentences.en: Oh, you know, she's the greatest of all time.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你认为为什么人们会以不同的眼光看待她们？

sentences.en: And no wonder she's terrified to look at the things that she can do.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But was that also your reading?
sentences.zh: 我也不知道大阪直美站出来是否真的有助于让西蒙·拜尔斯的情况正常化。

sentences.en: I mean, why do you think that would have been that people saw them in different lights?
sentences.zh: 当西蒙·拜尔斯出来谈论她的问题时，人们会说，哦，哇，这种情况发生得越来越频繁了。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不确定区别在哪里。

sentences.en: And I don't know if Naomi Osaka speaking up actually helped normalize it for Simone Biles.
sentences.zh: 她们退出比赛的原因肯定不同。

sentences.en: And by the time Simone Biles came out and talked about her issues, they were like, oh, wow, this has been happening more frequently.
sentences.zh: 你知道，西蒙·拜尔斯是因为心理障碍，而大阪直美提到的是心理健康问题、抑郁症和媒体压力，而西蒙面临的是一种危险的心理障碍，

sentences.en: I'm not sure of the difference.
sentences.zh: 如果她继续比赛，她可能会摔断脖子，你知道，或者更糟。

sentences.en: There were certainly different reasons that were given for backing out.
sentences.zh: 所以也许那种认为西蒙·拜尔斯面临的压力源后果更危险的看法，可能影响了公众的反应。

sentences.en: You know, Simone Biles with the mental block and Naomi Osaka cited just mental health issues
sentences.zh: 我也不想忽视这一切背后的社会文化和政治因素，你知道，她们是有色人种女性。

sentences.en: and depression and the media, media pressure versus, oh, there's a dangerous mental block
sentences.zh: 与白人男性相比，反应是否不同？比如当迈克尔·菲尔普斯（Michael Phelps）站出来谈论他的心理健康问题时。

sentences.en: going on where Simone continued, she could have broken her neck, you know, or something worse.
sentences.zh: 所以思考这个问题很有趣。

sentences.en: And so maybe that perception of, oh, there were more dangerous consequences of this stressor for Simone Biles than Naomi Osaka maybe affected the reaction.
sentences.zh: 我不一定有答案，但我认为这是一个人们需要思考的重要视角，即他们如何对待有色人种或少数群体，与对待多数群体的人有何不同。

sentences.en: And I don't want to dismiss also the socio-cultural and political aspects of all this with, you know, they are women of color.
sentences.zh: 最后一个问题。

sentences.en: And is there a different reaction for them versus if it was a white male, like when Michael
sentences.zh: 你认为这些围绕运动员心理健康的讨论会对心理健康污名化产生持久的影响吗，无论是在体育界内部还是外部？

sentences.en: Phelps came out and talked about his mental health issues.
sentences.zh: 我希望如此。

sentences.en: So it's interesting to think about.
sentences.zh: 很多人将运动员视为名人，关注他们的行为并模仿他们的做法。

sentences.en: I don't have necessarily an answer to that, but I think that's an important perspective
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这种情况不会消失。

sentences.en: that people need to think about is how they're reacting to people of color or minorities versus people in the majority.
sentences.zh: 如果有的话，我认为它会持续扩大。

sentences.en: So last question.
sentences.zh: 看看奥运会期间媒体对它的关注，我认为媒体关注度只会持续增加，越来越多的运动员会感到舒适地公开谈论这个问题。

sentences.en: Do you think these discussions around athletes' mental health will have a lasting impact on mental health stigma, both inside and outside the world of sports?
sentences.zh: 就像我之前说的，我希望它能渗透到青少年或竞技水平较低的体育领域，那里也有压力，也有负担，希望污名化能减少，人们能更舒适地寻求帮助，并知道去哪里寻求帮助。

sentences.en: I hope so.
sentences.zh: 我认为这也是困难所在，即知道谁受过什么训练。

sentences.en: And so many people look highly at athletes as celebrities and look at what they're doing and model what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们讨论过这个问题，持证心理健康专业人员与受过心理表现训练的人之间的区别。

sentences.en: So I don't think this is going to go away.
sentences.zh: 有些人两者都受过训练。

sentences.en: If anything, I think it's going to keep getting bigger.
sentences.zh: 所以对于公众来说，了解哪种专业人员适合在这种情况下去帮助我的孩子或我自己，这一点很重要。

sentences.en: Just looking at the media attention it got during the Olympics, I think it's just going
sentences.zh: 所以我确实希望它能减少污名化，所有这些关于心理健康的讨论，我希望它不会消失，因为这是人类和表现中非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: to keep increasing in terms of media attention and more and more athletes feeling comfortable speaking out about this.
sentences.zh: 好的，感谢您今天加入我们。

sentences.en: And like I said before, I hope it trickles down to youth or less competitive levels of sport, that there are stressors there, too, and pressures there, too, and that hopefully
sentences.zh: 与您交谈非常愉快。

sentences.en: the stigma does reduce and people are more comfortable asking for help and knowing where to go for help.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一次非常有趣的对话。

sentences.en: I think that's hard, too, is knowing who's trained in what.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，夏皮罗（Shapiro）博士。

sentences.en: And I know we had talked about this, the licensed mental health professional versus someone who's trained for mental performance.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢再次邀请我。

sentences.en: And there are people who are trained in both.
sentences.zh: 您可以在speakingofpsychology.org或Apple、Spotify、Stitcher或您获取喜爱的播客的任何地方找到《心理学谈话》（Speaking of Psychology）的往期节目。

sentences.en: And so it's just important for people in the public to know what professional is appropriate to help my child or help myself in this situation.
sentences.zh: 请给我们留下评论。

sentences.en: So I do hope it reduces stigma, all this talk about mental health, and I hope it doesn't go away because it's such an important part of humanity and performance.
